repairAssignments.decisiveDefect: participant-instructions.md is a list of blanks and nothing else. It never names the court the route files with, never states a waiver route, and never states who must be served or how; and it declares a caption-table rule a participant obligation.

failedProofObligations.finding: Of the 5 blanks the map declares REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, the four "Court Address" blanks on 1002EX and 1022EX are named by "- Judicial district and court street address for the filing venue". The fifth, 1002EX blankId p1-y296.76-x65.88 captured as "1. Certificate of eligibility is not required", is named by no instruction line. Reading the source bytes at that position shows why: the caption was taken from the numbered paragraph below it (printed at page 1 y=273.5), while the measured rule at y=296.76 spanning x65.88-x324.12 is the bottom border of the caption table's left cell. It is a table rule, not a blank, and on this route no certificate of eligibility is required at all, so there is nothing for the participant to supply.

participant-instructions.md never tells the participant where to file. It lists "Judicial district and court street address for the filing venue" as a blank the participant must supply, which is the opposite of naming the destination, and it never mentions the district court that receives the traffic expungement or deletion petition. The packet's own caption does carry route-determined evidence of a destination — the "In the [ ] District [ ] Justice Court of Utah" election is marked District and the county is written — but a marked caption box is not the instructions naming a court.

The court filing fee is stated: the packet fills and selects the district-court cover sheet row "$150 [ ] Expungement Petition - Criminal (E)" on 1044XX page 2, proved by an X read from the output bytes at x355.98 y359.1 inside that row's bracket. No waiver route is stated anywhere in the packet or the instructions — no fee-waiver motion is included, named or referenced.

The instructions never state who must be served or how. The only service line, "Service method, address, date, and certification only after service occurs", hands the participant the method and the recipient as blanks to fill in, and the closing sentence records that service certifications are protected. Neither names a recipient or a method.

repairAssignments.repairScope: Two separable repairs. (1) A packet-instruction repair lane rewrites participant-instructions.md to name the district court the route files with and to state the waiver route and the service recipient and method, from sourced facts only; the court filing fee is already stated on the cover sheet the packet fills. (2) A field-map repair lane drops 1002EX blankId p1-y296.76-x65.88 from the writable/declared set: the measured rule is the caption table's cell border and its caption was taken from the paragraph below it, so it is neither a blank nor a participant obligation. Do not repair either in a verification lane.
repairAssignments.whatThisDoesNotChange: Eleven of the fifteen obligations pass on measurement made in this lane, including every source digest recomputed from the Master Library bytes and both artifact hashes recomputed from the PDF bytes. The packet's fill is sound; its participant-facing instructions and two blank dispositions are not.

repairAssignments.decisiveDefect: The packet tells the participant that no committed record it binds states a filing fee or waiver for this route. The compiled Wyoming profile, which this family pins by exact SHA-256 and which rehashes MATCH here, carries the row 'Human-trafficking victim vacatur Verify with clerk; statute is a motion route, not a standard expungement filing-fee route' -- twice, at packetGenerator.feeRules[4] and sourceSections[9].text -- keyed to this route by its own label, inside a table whose other rows are keyed to 7-13-1401/1501/1502/14-6-241. failedProofObligations.finding: A blanket denial about the REPOSITORY that is false against the bound profile. This is the exact A2 error pattern the determination names, and independently an A4 internal-consistency failure. What is withheld is not an amount -- there is none -- but the reason, which is the participant's instrument at the clerk's counter: a participant quoted the $300 felony-expungement fee has nothing to say unless told this is a motion route rather than a standard expungement filing.
The census pin is stale, as for GA and MS. The other two bound records (routes/single-routes.json and WY-wyoming.json) verify exactly.

repairAssignments.repairScope: Two separable repairs. (1) FEE_AND_WAIVER: replace the blanket denial with what the profile holds -- that no amount is established for this route AND that the profile records it as a motion route rather than a standard expungement filing-fee route, so the standard expungement schedule does not apply -- keeping the clerk as the named authority for the amount, and keeping the authority in the same breath as the money statement per A2's answersVT13B1 guidance. (2) SOURCE_IDENTITY: the shared census re-pin described on the GA and MS assignments.
repairAssignments.notForThisLaneToInfer: Whether the delivered document should be captioned a Motion rather than a Petition, given that the same profile names the instrument 'Motion to Vacate Conviction under W.S. 6-2-708', is raised as VA10-Q1 and not decided here. It bears on the fee question -- a filing docketed as a new civil action is where the standard fee attaches -- so a repairer touching the fee sentence should read that question rather than route around it.

repairAssignments.decisiveDefect: participant-instructions.md tells the participant twice that the petition carries their mailing address -- the component table says 'with your name, date of birth, mailing address and phone written in' and the closing section says 'with the four facts the platform holds written into it' -- and the delivered bytes carry three writes and no address. Measured on both fixtures: the mailing_address write box (x=105 y=484 w=171 h=13, i.e. y_top 295-308) contains only the form's own printed captions; the 171-point run from x=105 to x=276 is empty in canonical.pdf and empty in boundary.pdf.

failedProofObligations.finding: The packet states it wrote a fact it did not write. The direction of harm is the worse one: a participant who believes the address is on the form does not transcribe it and files a petition the Probation Service cannot answer. Three other sentences in the same document say the opposite, which is why a reader cannot tell which to believe.

Of the five selfHelpStopConditions the committed track registry holds for ma-expunge-time, condition 3 -- 'Whether offences arose from a single incident for counting purposes is unclear' -- is absent in any form. 'incident', 'arising from', 'arose', 'counting' and 'count as one' return 0 hits in participant-instructions.md and 0 in the delivered canonical bytes. The same registry entry holds the rule that resolves it, in its exclusions: 'Multiple offences arising from the same incident count as one.' A participant with three charges from one arrest reads the two-record limit, counts three, and abandons a route they may be eligible for.

repairAssignments.repairScope: Two small, separable edits, neither of which touches a fixture. (1) Correct the component table and the closing section to say three facts -- name, date of birth, phone -- and not four; the rest of the document already describes the address correctly and needs no change. (2) Add the counting rule and its stop condition: state that multiple offences arising from the same incident count as one, and add a stop bullet for the case where it is unclear whether offences arose from a single incident. Both are prose repairs to participant-instructions.md and the composed guidance component; the petition's ink is correct as it stands and should not be touched.
repairAssignments.notForThisLaneToInfer: Whether the same-incident counting rule reaches a given participant's record is a legal question and stays with counsel. What is measured here is that the repository states the rule and states that uncertainty about it is where self-help stops, and the packet publishes neither. Separately, the registry's open release blocker on whether the 2018-10-11 revision is still the published edition is untouched by this repair and remains outstanding.

Page 5 of the delivered canonical fixture carries 'County of Example County', 'Case No. 24-CR-001234' and 'Jordan Avery Reyes' -- three of this build's own writes. repairAssignments.repairScope: A prose repair to participant-instructions.md, with no change to any fixture, field map or build script. Then correct the items table row to match. Confirm against the source form before writing: the four dual-widget fields are enumerable with pdf-lib in about ten lines. While there, decide whether the boundary case needs its own sentence, since a refused long name leaves page 5's defendant line blank and a participant in that position DOES have something to copy.

failedProofObligations.finding: The packet asks for facts it has already printed on the same page, which is the A4 class: printing 'What is your date of birth?' as a blank one inch below 'Date of birth: 1991-04-17' tells the participant it does not state something it does state. On a pleading the harm is concrete -- a participant who complies writes their name and date of birth twice on one petition and gives a clerk an inconsistency to resolve; one who does not comply cannot tell whether they have skipped a required item. The packet's own framing shows the intent it missed: it calls section C facts 'about your own case' that 'belong to the record itself', which is true of C5-C17 and false of C1-C3.

repairAssignments.repairScope: Two separable repairs. (1) KNOWN_PREFILLS: drop C2 and C3 from all three petitions and from the instructions' three items tables, and narrow C1 to the limb that is genuinely not held -- any other name the case is under. C4, county of residence, is correctly a blank and stays: nothing in the packet supplies a Mississippi county. repairAssignments.notForThisLaneToInfer: Whether the re-pin is done family-by-family or once across every family that binds this census. This is not a Tennessee-local defect — an earlier lane (commit e44471221) measured the same drift across all 31 families binding this record. That lane's prescription, "one re-pin, not 31 rebuilds", was correct at its own base, where the census was still e881e8493e694cfcc99f714cbdcfc0424cab8c4a7d22b3e3a9913daab6816ab2 and every anchor was intact. So the blanket re-pin is right for Tennessee and wrong for Kansas, and whoever executes it must check anchors per family rather than re-pinning on the strength of the earlier finding.

repairAssignments.decisiveDefect: Two defects, either of which alone fails the family. First: the delivered boundary filing loses the participant's own name and street address off the right edge of the page, cut mid-word, on four pages including the Cover Letter to Court — 7 words fall outside the 612x792 page box where the official source has 0 — while reports/actual-writes.json records the same writes as 'fit' and 'shrunk'. Second: participant-instructions.md answers none of FILING_DESTINATION, FEE_AND_WAIVER, SERVICE or SELF_HELP_STOP, and instead carries the catch-all sentence 'Confirm current revision, filing destination, local procedures, fees, attachments, service, and proposed-order requirements before filing' — sending the participant to establish four facts that the committed track registry holds and that the packet's own enclosed kit prints on its face.

failedProofObligations.finding: Measured from pdftotext -bbox-layout word rectangles against each page's own MediaBox: official CN-10557 0 words outside the page box, canonical fixture 0, boundary fixture 7 — 'Montgomery-Vanden' xMax 618.97 (p.23), 'Fitzwilliam' 619.69 / 'Montgomery-Vandenberg-' 615.29 / 'Northeas' 618.07 (p.35), 'Montgomery-Vandenberg-Oye' 616.15 / 'Bu' 618.59 (p.38), 'Fitzwillia' 614.51 (p.43). Confirmed in pixels at raster/cn-10557-boundary/page-35.png, where the Cover Letter's signature block reads 'Alexandrina-Katharine Montgomery-V' and the address reads '12345 Southwest Grandview Bouleva'.
failedProofObligations.whatRepairMustDo: Clip flattened participant appearances to the widget rectangle, and compute shrink-to-fit PER WIDGET rather than once per field. DefName carries 20 widgets from 208 to 366 points wide and reports/actual-writes.json records one fontSize (6.5) for the field; the narrow widgets still overflow at that size. Re-measure that the boundary fixture has 0 words outside the page box and that no value word extends past its own widget's right edge.
failedProofObligations.whatRepairMustNotDo: Do not shorten, abbreviate or line-wrap the participant's legal name to make it fit. A name that does not fit is a layout defect, not a data defect.

Missing on both: ExpungeCntyName (factId matter.county; four widgets on pages 18, 27, 30 and 40 — the Petition caption, the Order for Hearing, the Expungement Order and the Final Order). Missing additionally on the boundary: dismissOff1 (matter.charge, page 18 item a) and arrest1CaseNum (matter.case_number, page 31 row 1). failedProofObligations.whatRepairMustDo: Resolve each of the three, and make the map tell the truth about the outcome. If the finalizer is right to withhold the caption county — and it may be: the caption asks for the county the participant FILES in, while matter.county is derived from the residence fixture — then ExpungeCntyName must stop declaring decision 'candidate_write' and must instead carry an explicit refusal with requiredBeforeFiling true, disclosed in participant-instructions.md. If dismissOff1 and arrest1CaseNum are dropped because the value did not fit, that is the same fit defect as above and they must be written once it is fixed. A write that silently does not happen is the one outcome that must not survive this repair.
